title: [tc3] Add Job Manager library
body:
# Description

Add `JobManager` and `Job` types, test for basic functionality.

* `StartJob` will start a job with the provided parameters and begin logging the output of the job to a buffer which can subsequently be read by multiple clients simultaneously, without blocking.
* `StopJob` will stop a job in progress.
* `StreamOutput` will stream the output of a job to an output source, starting with the log buffer, and continuing through to live output lines until the job is complete.
* `GetStatus` returns the status of a job - whether it is initializing, running, done or has reached an error state.

Since I don't yet have cgroups set up for the application, I'm intentionally omitting that functionality at this time. Once that is in place, I'll be able to add it to the `JobManager` and test.

Resolves #3
